CLIP (with atom IDs): E02.006 | 00:13.00-00:16.00 | CAM | Low angle on the widow framed against the lighthouse beam.
E02.007 | 00:13.40-00:15.80 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, triumphant) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
E02.008 | 00:14.50-00:16.00 | SFX | A string sting swells to a peak.
E02.009 | 00:16.00-00:22.00 | CAM | Close-up on the widow's hands gripping the rail.
E02.010 | 00:16.40-00:19.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, silken) | "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
E02.011 | 00:22.00-00:26.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from the widow toward Tobin.
E02.012 | 00:26.00-00:32.00 | CAM | Close-up on Corin's hands gripping the rail.
E02.013 | 00:26.40-00:29.82 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (afraid, gruff) | "I saw who slipped the ring into your shawl."
E02.014 | 00:32.00-00:35.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Corin's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E02.015 | 00:32.40-00:34.80 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, cold) | "The council has already decided her fate."
E02.016 | 00:35.00-00:39.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E02.017 | 00:35.40-00:38.44 | DLG | SELENE (O.S., shrill, cruel) | "You think a scarred stranger can save you?"
E02.018 | 00:39.00-00:45.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Tobin and Mara, the space between them charged.
E02.019 | 00:39.40-00:40.92 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (venomous, furious) | "Drink deep, little lamp-keeper."
E02.020 | 00:45.00-00:50.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Selene's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E02.021 | 00:45.40-00:47.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (triumphant, pompous) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
